description: This is a PHP class file defining the Affiliate controller within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles email notifications related to affiliate account events, such as sending registration confirmations and alerts to admin users.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for handling affiliate email notifications in OpenCart, including registration confirmation and alert emails.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending an affiliate registration email when a new affiliate is registered.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert emails to admin when a new affiliate account is created, if configured.
